paragraphs.en: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we’ve ever released.
paragraphs.zh: 隆重推出 Claude Haiku 5.5：我们迄今为止发布的 cheapest、fastest 且最强大的小型模型。

paragraphs.en: Claude Haiku 5.5 is designed for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks. It reliably handles quick and repetitive workloads (like summaries, compactions, database queries, and classification requests). It pairs well with Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 as a subagent on coding work. And, since it’s also our fastest model to date, it works especially well for speed-sensitive tasks like live customer support and browser use.¹
paragraphs.zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 专为高吞吐量、成本敏感的任务而设计。 它能可靠地处理快速且重复的工作负载（如摘要、压缩、数据库查询和分类请求）。 在编码工作中，它作为子智能体与 Opus 5.5 和 Sonnet 5.5 搭配使用效果很好。 此外，由于它也是我们迄今最快的模型，因此在实时客户支持和浏览器使用等对速度敏感的任务中表现尤为出色。¹

paragraphs.en: Haiku 5.5 is available at a much lower price than Haiku 4.5. On average, it now costs around 75% less to run.²
paragraphs.zh: Haiku 5.5 的价格远低于 Haiku 4.5。 平均而言，其运行成本现在降低了约 75%。²

paragraphs.en: Along with this launch, we’re making improvements to the value of our model range. We’re halving the price of Claude Sonnet 5.5’s cache reads, which means Sonnet 5.5 now runs around 20% cheaper on most agentic work. And we’re introducing a new monthly API credit for our Claude Max and Team subscribers, designed to support our users in building new agents and applications that run on the Claude Platform.
paragraphs.zh: 随着本次发布，我们正在提升旗下模型系列的价值。 我们将 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格减半，这意味着 Sonnet 5.5 在大多数智能体工作负载上的运行成本现在降低约 20%。 我们还将为 Claude Max 和 Team 订阅用户推出新的每月 API 额度，旨在支持用户在 Claude 平台上构建新的智能体和应用程序。

paragraphs.en: “We’re very impressed with Claude Haiku 5.5, particularly its speed. We ran it through our eval suite for AI Teammates, our AI agent product, covering use cases like triaging bugs, setting up projects, and searching large portfolios to surface high-risk or overdue work. Compared with the model we use today, we saw over a 30% reduction in latency for task completions and up to 2.5x faster inference per agent turn. It’s a noticeably snappier experience.”
paragraphs.zh: “Claude Haiku 5.5 给我们留下了深刻印象，尤其是它的速度。 我们用面向 AI Teammates（我们的 AI 智能体产品）的评测套件对它进行了测试，涵盖用例包括缺陷分类、项目搭建，以及在大规模作品集中检索以发现高风险或逾期的工作。 与我们目前使用的模型相比，任务完成的延迟降低了 30% 以上，每个智能体回合的推理速度最高提升 2.5 倍。 体验明显更加灵敏流畅。

paragraphs.en: “At HubSpot, we use simulated portals to evaluate new models on CRM tasks like reporting on deals. We mostly test the smaller, more efficient models, and Claude Haiku 5.5 got the best score we’ve seen on this suite yet, at 92.8% averaged over three runs. One CRM audit task asks models to identify stale but ambiguous records. Across all of the models we tested, Haiku 5.5 was fastest to complete the task, and had the highest hit rate and the lowest false positive rate.”
paragraphs.zh: “在 HubSpot，我们使用模拟门户来评估新模型在 CRM 任务（例如交易报告）上的表现。 我们主要测试更小、更高效的模型，而 Claude Haiku 5.5 在这套测试中取得了我们迄今为止见过的最佳成绩，三次运行平均得分为 92.8%。 有一项 CRM 审计任务要求模型识别过时但含义模糊的记录。 在我们测试的所有模型中，Haiku 5.5 完成任务的速度最快，命中率最高，误报率最低。”

paragraphs.en: “Ask in Document is one of our big sources of spend, doing about 8M calls a week in production. It answers very specific questions on top of one or a few documents. We ran 400 queries, and Claude Haiku 5.5 was a statistically significant improvement over Haiku 4.5: 0.84 vs. 0.76.”
paragraphs.zh: 「文档内提问」是我们支出的大头之一，在生产环境中每周约有 800 万次调用。 它基于一份或少数几份文档回答非常具体的问题。 我们运行了 400 个查询，Claude Haiku 5.5 相比 Haiku 4.5 有统计显著的提升：0.84 对 0.76。

paragraphs.en: “Our customers use Box AI across large volumes of their enterprise content. With widespread usage comes the need to manage efficiency and cost, and to find the best model to suit the task at hand. In early testing, Claude Haiku 5.5 scored 11 points higher than Haiku 4.5 at about half the latency. We’d put it to use on analytical work that runs at scale, from cost reports to financial summaries and weekly recurring reviews.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们的客户在大量企业内容中使用 Box AI。 随着使用范围的扩大，就需要管理效率与成本，并找到最适合手头任务的最佳模型。 在早期测试中，Claude Haiku 5.5 的得分比 Haiku 4.5 高出 11 分，而延迟大约只有一半。 我们将它用于大规模运行的分析工作，从成本报告、财务摘要到每周例行审查。”

paragraphs.en: “The short and high-volume work is where Claude Haiku 5.5 fits for us, like quick lookups, subagents, and summaries. While a bigger model builds the deck, a Haiku 5.5 subagent goes into the 10-K and pulls the segment revenue line the deck needs. It’s accurate enough that we’d trust it there, and fast and cheap enough that we can run it a lot.”
paragraphs.zh: 「短平快、高吞吐量的工作正是 Claude Haiku 5.5 适合我们的场景，比如快速查询、子智能体和摘要。 当更大的模型在制作演示文稿时，一个 Haiku 5.5 子智能体会进入 10-K 文件，提取演示文稿所需的分部收入数据行。 它的准确度足以让我们放心在此场景使用，而且速度快、成本低，可以大量运行。」

paragraphs.en: Alignment. Claude Haiku 5.5 shows major improvements across almost all of our alignment evaluations relative to Haiku 4.5. In particular, we found far fewer instances of misaligned behavior, and a lower willingness to cooperate with misuse. The model’s system card describes our evaluation process and results in more detail.
paragraphs.zh: 对齐。 相较于 Haiku 4.5，Claude Haiku 5.5 在我们几乎所有的对齐评估中都表现出了显著提升。 特别值得注意的是，我们发现模型出现失范行为的情况大幅减少，配合滥用的意愿也更低。 模型的系统卡更详细地描述了我们的评估过程和结果。

sents.en: Alignment.
sents.zh: 对齐。

sents.en: Claude Haiku 5.5 shows major improvements across almost all of our alignment evaluations relative to Haiku 4.5.

paragraphs.en: Safeguards. Consistent with its capabilities, Haiku 5.5’s cybersecurity safeguards are more restrictive than Haiku 4.5’s, but somewhat less restrictive than those we’ve applied to other recent models. In cybersecurity, they permit a wider range of defensive tasks than our safeguards for Sonnet 5.5, but they still block penetration testing and other techniques more likely to be used by attackers.
paragraphs.zh: 安全防护措施。 在其能力范围内，Haiku 5.5 的网络安全防护措施比 Haiku 4.5 的更为严格，但比我们近期其他模型所采用的防护措施略为宽松。 在网络安全领域，这些防护措施允许的范围比 Sonnet 5.5 的防护措施更广，涵盖更多防御性任务，但仍会阻止渗透测试及其他更可能被攻击者使用的技术。

sents.en: Safeguards.
sents.zh: 安全防护措施。

paragraphs.en: Haiku 5.5’s biology safeguards are the same as for Sonnet 5, Sonnet 5.5, and Opus 5. They allow research biology questions but restrict access to requests that we judge as likely to cause harm. Organizations working on wider-ranging biology and cyber activities can apply to our Life Sciences Verification Program and Cyber Verification Program .
paragraphs.zh: Haiku 5.5 的生物安全防护措施与 Sonnet 5、Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5 相同。 它们允许研究性的生物学问题，但会限制我们判断为可能造成危害的请求。 从事更广泛生物学和网络活动的组织可以申请我们的生命科学验证计划和网络验证计划。

paragraphs.en: Alongside our new pricing for Claude Haiku 5.5, we’re making further improvements to the value of our models and products.
paragraphs.zh: 随着我们推出 Claude Haiku 5.5 的新定价，我们将进一步改进我们模型和产品的价值。

paragraphs.en: First, starting today, we’re lowering the price of cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5 . Cache reads now cost 50% less: $0.10 per million tokens rather than $0.20. Because cache reads make up a large share of models’ token consumption, this reduces the cost of Sonnet 5.5 on most agentic tasks by around 20%.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，从今天开始，我们下调了 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格。 缓存读取的价格现在降低了 50%：由每百万 tokens 0.20 美元降至 0.10 美元。 由于缓存读取在模型的 token 消耗中占很大比重，此举可将 Sonnet 5.5 在大多数智能体任务上的成本降低约 20%。

sents.en: First, starting today, we’re lowering the price of cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5 .
sents.zh: 首先，从今天开始，我们下调了 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格。

paragraphs.en: Terminal-Bench 4.0 measures how well a model can complete complex, multi-step professional tasks within a command-line interface.
paragraphs.zh: Terminal-Bench 4.0 衡量模型在命令行界面中完成复杂、多步骤专业任务的能力。

paragraphs.en: This chart illustrates an important difference between Haiku 5.5 and our larger models. Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 remain better choices for complex agentic coding tasks like those measured by Terminal-Bench 4.0. By contrast, Haiku 5.5 is best suited to more narrowly scoped tasks that might otherwise have been cost-prohibitive with previous versions of Claude—like compaction, summarization, or subagent work.
paragraphs.zh: 这张图表展示了 Haiku 5.5 与我们更大规模模型之间的重要差异。 对于像 Terminal-Bench 4.0 所测量的那些复杂智能体编码任务，Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5.5 仍然是更好的选择。 相比之下，Haiku 5.5 最适合范围更窄的任务——这类任务若使用以前版本的 Claude，成本可能高得令人望而却步——例如压缩、摘要或子智能体工作。

paragraphs.en: Second, this week, we’ll roll out a new monthly API credit to all Max and Team subscribers for use on the Claude Platform . Max 5x users will get $100 in credits per month, Max 20x users will get $200, and Team subscribers will receive up to $500, pooled across their users. These credits are designed to allow our users to experiment with building tools, apps, and agents that call our API. They can be used on any of our models. For more information, see our Help Center article .
paragraphs.zh: 其次，本周我们将向所有 Max 和 Team 订阅者推出新的每月 API 额度，供其在 Claude Platform 上使用。 Max 5x 用户每月将获得 100 美元额度，Max 20x 用户将获得 200 美元，Team 订阅者将获得最高 500 美元，由其团队成员共享。 这些额度旨在让我们的用户能够尝试构建调用我们 API 的工具、应用和智能体。 这些额度可用于我们的任何模型。 有关更多信息，请参阅我们的帮助中心文章。

paragraphs.en: For developers, we’re also updating our Claude Python and TypeScript SDKs to add support for computer use and browser use in beta. Haiku 5.5 is especially well-suited to these tasks, given its combination of speed, capability, and price. You can read more about this in our Claude Platform docs .
paragraphs.zh: 对于开发者，我们还在更新我们的 Claude Python 和 TypeScript SDK，以测试版形式增加对计算机使用和浏览器使用的支持。 Haiku 5.5 特别适合这些任务，因为它兼具速度、能力和价格优势。 你可以在我们的 Claude Platform 文档 中阅读更多相关内容。

sents.en: Haiku 5.5 is especially well-suited to these tasks, given its combination of speed, capability, and price.
sents.zh: Haiku 5.5 特别适合这些任务，因为它兼具速度、能力和价格优势。

sents.en: You can read more about this in our Claude Platform docs .
sents.zh: 你可以在我们的 Claude Platform 文档 中阅读更多相关内容。

paragraphs.en: 1 Claude Haiku 5.5 is our fastest model to date at each model’s standard speed, although it runs less quickly than our Opus models in Fast Mode.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 是我们在各模型标准速度下迄今为止最快的模型，不过它在快速模式（Fast Mode）下的运行速度比我们的 Opus 模型要慢。

paragraphs.en: 2 Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced 90% lower than Claude Haiku 4.5 for requests up to 100,000 tokens, and 50% lower for requests over 100,000 tokens. On Haiku 4.5, 90% of requests fell into the former category. This calculation also accounts for changes between Haiku 4.5 and Haiku 5.5 in how many tokens are used to complete a given piece of work: Haiku 5.5 has an updated tokenizer (similar to Sonnet 5.5’s and Opus 5.5’s), which means it uses slightly more tokens per task.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 对不超过 100,000 token 的请求定价比 Claude Haiku 4.5 低 90%，对超过 100,000 token 的请求低 50%。 在 Haiku 4.5 上，90% 的请求属于前一类。 这项计算还考虑了 Haiku 4.5 与 Haiku 5.5 在完成给定工作量时所使用 token 数量上的差异：Haiku 5.5 采用了更新后的分词器（与 Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5.5 的类似），这意味着它每个任务会使用略多的 token。
